experiments.change_desc: strategy sweep: mh=3+sl=3% on d_ffn=128 (35w full)
experiments.note: mh=3+sl=3% gives higher total return (312.9% vs 229.1%) but slightly lower RDD (2.94 vs 3.02). Current d_ffn=128 baseline at RDD=3.02/Sharpe=1.14 is already strong. mh=3 alone hurts (RDD 1.34) — model produces well-distributed scores that benefit from diversification.
500-day window for faster adaptation. Sharpe=0.937, Return=177.7%, MaxDD=-26.3%
3-day label much noisier. RDD 1.06 vs baseline 3.02. Short-term returns dominated by noise and momentum continuation that conflicts with reversal factors. 5-day label confirmed as optimal.

LHB data is extremely sparse (99%+ zeros). cs_rank on sparse data produces constants for majority of stocks. 5 constant-like factors dilute attention on existing 143 strong factors. Same failure mode as V15.6/7/8. LHB better suited as post-prediction score adjustment overlay.
retrain_days=30 gives 53 windows vs 35 baseline. More retraining = more noise from shorter prediction periods. Consistent with exp_010/011/021. retrain_days=45 confirmed optimal.

Ensemble=3 matched RDD (3.02=3.02) but Sharpe degraded (1.02 vs 1.14) and total return lower (197% vs 229%). Ensemble smoothing reduces extreme predictions that drive concentrated alpha. Not an improvement — the single-model already has sufficient signal quality.

experiments.change_desc: data_layer: valid_len=50 (vs 100 baseline) — more training data
experiments.note: Reducing validation window from 100 to 50 days gives model 650 training days (vs 600). RDD 3.02->3.45 (+14%), Sharpe 1.14->1.49 (+31%), Return 229%->397% (+73%). 50 days of validation still provides adequate early stopping signal while the extra training data improves pattern learning. Confirmed as improvement over baseline.
